input.goal: Introduce one current pagination interface across server and client, migrate affected callers, and verify integration and data recovery.
acceptance: Server, client and affected callers use the same approved current pagination contract.
End-to-end and failure-path tests pass on the final integrated candidate after caller migration.
Existing pagination behavior and persisted data remain correct under the approved current contract.
Rollback and data recovery are rehearsed with isolated fixtures; production deployment is out of scope.
constraints: No production data migration or auto-merge.
Shared contracts are approved before dependent implementations start.

work_units.instructions: Define the approved current pagination contract, map affected callers, and own the shared consumer fixtures.
Implement the current contract and migrate affected server callers in an isolated workspace.
Implement the current contract and migrate affected client callers in an isolated workspace.
Verify caller migration, end-to-end and failure behavior, and rollback/data recovery against the integrated candidate.
